findings.evidence: Seven controls are labelled only "COPY" (sweep repeated_label: 'Copy' x7); out of context a screen-reader list reads 'Copy, Copy, Copy...'. Instruction says 'CLICK ANY CARD TO COPY' with no confirmation text captured.
findings.after: <button aria-label="Copy Claude Code install commands">Copy</button> plus a polite live region announcing 'Copied'
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose / 2.4.6 Headings and Labels, and 4.1.3 Status Messages for the copy confirmation.

findings.evidence: Sweep focus_ring: focused element covered by the fixed header. focus.json confirms covered=true at y 3528 while the neighbouring FIG. 04A button is not covered.
findings.after: html { scroll-padding-top: <header height> } so focused targets scroll clear of the bar
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum). Sweep hit verified as plausible.

findings.evidence: Real sentences are set in ~9.5-11px tracked uppercase mono: the quote attribution 'CATHRYN LAVERY · A GENERIC TOOL ASKS “WHERE SHOULD THIS BOX GO?” ...' (112 chars at 11px) and section sub-lines; uppercase long runs are slower to read and the light grey on cream is faint in the tile.
findings.before: font: 11px mono; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em on sentences
findings.after: Sentences at >= 14px in the body face, sentence case; keep caps mono for short labels only
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.8 Visual Presentation (AAA advisory) and 1.4.12 readability; the 11px size meets no-floor but not comfortable reading.

findings.evidence: The theme switch is one button named 'DARK LIGHT' with the active option shown only by a black fill on 'LIGHT'.
findings.after: <button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Dark theme">…</button>, or a two-option radiogroup with aria-checked
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 1.4.1 Use of Color: state not exposed.

findings.evidence: focus.json: a link whose name is just '66k' (star icon + number) points to the GitHub repo, next to a second link 'GITHUB' to the same URL.
findings.after: aria-label="66k stars on GitHub" or merge with the GITHUB link

strengths: Alt text is exemplary: each diagram's alt says what it shows ('State machine showing an article moving from Draft through In Review and Published to Archived, including rejection and revision').
Every focus stop has a 2px terracotta outline; focus order follows the visual order (nav, hero CTAs, figures, gallery 01-45).
Main, nav, header and footer landmarks present; the product claims accessible diagrams and the page mostly backs it.
not_investigated: Gallery thumbnails lazy-loaded and not rendered at capture; their in-place contrast not checked.
Demo video blocked; captions/controls for FIG. 00 unverified (it says '17S · NO SOUND').
Animated axonometric examples (separate pages) and the enlarge dialog's Escape/focus return not tested live.
